name: dsh-auto-rename
description: DSH Web /auto-rename: have the AI read the whole session and rename it automatically to YYYY-MM-DD_语义名 — on demand as a slash command, or by itself after a configurable idle window (default 5 minutes). DSH Web 斜杠命令 /auto-rename + 空闲自动改名：每轮对话结束后无人操作满 5 分钟，自动让 AI 通读会话并改名为 YYYY-MM-DD_语义名。
